A fourth transaction (motorway stop Heidiland/Maienfeld, 07:32 CEST) is consistent with the claimed departure to Flims. The garage log shows no return of the vehicle to St. Gallen. Physical impossibility is supported by multiple independent sources. The residual uncertainty deduction arises from: the absence of direct proof of Confluence access (K1 knowledge), the unverifiable overnight stay with the friend, and the theoretically non-excluded possibility that Bernasconi could have used another vehicle or another person — for which, however, there are no indications whatsoever.
translations.t0041: Chiara Bernasconi is excluded as a suspect by time and location through three independent card transactions in Winterthur: payment at Restaurant Rössli 23:04 CEST (6 minutes before the start of the offence), fuel transaction Winterthur 06:15 CEST (17 minutes after the end of the offence), motorway stop Maienfeld 07:32 CEST (on the route Winterthur–Flims). Her notable knowledge (decompress-on-write, scratch pattern) was acquired through legitimate professional activity and was not exclusive; her early reporting of the anomaly without intent to conceal also speaks in her favour.
translations.t0042: Whether Bernasconi's Confluence account was among the 9 accounts with access to the Real/Decoy mapping has not been established in the case file.
translations.t0043: The overnight stay with a friend in Winterthur is supported only by Bernasconi's own statement; no independent confirmation from the friend is on record.
translations.t0044: Whether Bernasconi knew the undocumented current staging path (K2) has not been conclusively resolved.
translations.t0045: The expense audit (CHF 41,000) is not supported in the case file by a final approval document from the finance department.
translations.t0046: The card transactions establish the presence of Bernasconi's card — and plausibly her vehicle — in Winterthur, but strictly speaking not her physical person.
translations.t0047: Ammann's alibi for the night of the offence rests on her claim that she was in Lisbon. According to investigator's note NB-L75, flights, the hotel, and the photographer's raw files were checked — but the original records (boarding passes, booking confirmations, photographer timestamps) are not directly visible in the case file. What documents were specifically verified?
translations.t0048: Card records from the offence period (night of 10/11.10.2025) in Lisbon would be independent, non-assertion-based evidence of Ammann's location. CARD-L902 shows Hotel Lisboa on 10.10. at 18:05 CEST — are there further transactions on 10 or 11 October in Lisbon?
translations.t0049: The Slack entry SL-eng-infra-2025-10-10-L32 (23:48 CEST) does not necessarily prove she was physically in Lisbon. Are there further messages or activity signals from 11.10. that support or contradict her location?
translations.t0050: NB-L75 mentions 'photographer's timestamped raw files. Verified.' — were these files formally logged in the case file, or is only the investigator's note present? A separate confirmation would substantially strengthen the alibi.
translations.t0051: If Ammann's vehicle (ZH 610 882, Subaru Outback) never appeared in the garage log during the weekend of 10/11.10., that would be a further indication of absence. According to NB-L80, the garage log was not available until 01.12. — are there entries for this period?

EM-L153 shows that Renata removed the file from the shared folder but was unable to recall the PDF copy. How many people actually received the board pack, and which of them may have seen Slide 11?
translations.t0053: Ammann was active on Slack in the #eng-infra channel at 23:48 CEST (within the offence window), asking whether the collector window looked 'clean'.
translations.t0054: Ammann's knowledge of the Real/Decoy mapping was originally limited to five persons but was disseminated significantly more widely through two leaks: Slide 11 of the board pack (February 2025, distribution: board, CEO, presenting executive, deck assembler) and Yannick's Confluence page (March 2025, eng-all, 16 views, 9 accounts). The knowledge was therefore no longer exclusive to Ammann.
translations.t0055: Ammann herself warned that Slide 11 should not be circulated — she did not intend the dissemination.
translations.t0056: The board pack containing Slide 11 was sent to board@, dov.halperin and iris.ammann — at minimum board members and the CEO received the mapping.
translations.t0057: Yannick Favre published the control with default permissions on Confluence, giving the entire engineering organisation read access.
translations.t0058: Ammann herself raised the permissions issue as a ticket and attempted to contain the dissemination.
translations.t0059: Access to the storage tree alone was insufficient — even with the Confluence page and the board pack, one had to know which path corresponded to which bundle. The knowledge was more widely distributed, but the precise path mapping remained critical.
translations.t0060: The deactivation of the audit pipeline was operationally necessary (migration) and was widely communicated (ticket, #eng-infra, standup, ~40 persons). Ammann signed with explicit reluctance and documented conditions. The sign-off obligation lay explicitly with Security, so her signature was structurally mandated.
translations.t0061: Ammann signed visibly reluctantly and imposed explicit conditions — no indication of a strategic motivation to deactivate.
translations.t0062: The signature was compelled by the process, not voluntarily initiated.
translations.t0063: The window was known to ~40 persons — not exclusive knowledge on Ammann's part.
translations.t0064: Ammann disclosed her financial situation proactively and submitted a documented folder of evidence. The investigator confirmed that every franc was documented and traceable to her father's nursing home costs. This is an understandable personal burden, not unexplained wealth or suspicious transfers.
translations.t0065: The investigator reviewed the evidence folder and confirmed: all debts are explainable by care and legal costs and are fully documented.
translations.t0066: Ammann states the precise reason (cancelled care insurance, ongoing lawsuit, no contribution from her brother) and offers documentation.
translations.t0067: The total debt is substantial and the payment history is deteriorating — as a motive, the financial burden remains objectively present, even though its origin is explained.
translations.t0068: Ammann's Slack message at 23:48 CEST is compatible with her claimed location of Lisbon: the message can be sent from any device with an internet connection. She explained the message as a routine check from the hotel. Multiple independent pieces of evidence support that she was in fact in Lisbon.
translations.t0069: Card transaction at Hotel Avenida in Lisbon at 18:05 CEST on 10.10. — a few hours before the Slack message at 23:48 CEST.
translations.t0070: Purchase at Zurich Airport Duty Free on 09.10. at 16:40 CEST — consistent with the calendar entry for flight ZRH→LIS 18:05.

translations.t0072: Automatic out-of-office reply, activated on 09.10., references Lisbon and a family trip.
translations.t0073: The investigator explicitly confirms: flights, hotel and photographer's raw files with timestamps were checked and confirmed.
translations.t0074: Expense record confirms hotel stay in Lisbon on 10.10., not submitted as a personal expense.
translations.t0075: Calendar shows rehearsal dinner on 10.10. from 19:00 local time — during the offence window, Ammann was at a pre-wedding dinner.
translations.t0076: The phrasing 'from here' is subjective and non-location-specific — it does not prove the location, but it does not contradict it either.
translations.t0077: Ammann knew the Real/Decoy mapping first-hand. However, that knowledge had been disseminated significantly more widely than the original list of 5 through the board pack (February 2025, at minimum board + CEO) and Yannick's Confluence page (March 2025, eng-all, 9 accounts with views). Access to the undocumented staging path was also held, according to statements, by Lukas Hofer, Andrin Caduff and Yannick Favre. Ammann's knowledge was more precise, but no longer exclusive.
translations.t0078: As Head of Security, Ammann had comprehensive system access. She signed INFRA-2291 but did not initiate this and did so with documented reluctance. The exfiltration was carried out physically from a workstation console on the engineering floor — access that several persons with office entry rights possessed. The alley door was regularly propped open, so physical access was possible without a badge.
translations.t0079: For the entire offence window (23:10 CEST Friday to 05:58 CEST Saturday), converging investigator-verified evidence places Ammann in Lisbon: card transaction at Hotel Avenida Lisbon 18:05 CEST on 10.10., airport duty-free transaction Zurich 16:40 CEST on 09.10., calendar rehearsal dinner 19:00 CEST on 10.10., out-of-office reply, and investigator-confirmed flights, hotel and photographer's raw files with timestamps. The Slack message at 23:48 CEST is compatible with remote access from the hotel. No garage-log entry for ZH 610 882 during the offence period (the log begins 01.08.2025; next confirmed entry not until November 2025).
translations.t0080: Ammann's knowledge of the Real/Decoy mapping, the undocumented staging path and the decompression behaviour of the bundles remains the most detailed within the entire circle of suspects — even though it is no longer exclusive. This is not proof of guilt, but it is a structural finding.
translations.t0081: The financial burden (CHF 210,000 in debts, CHF 11,000/month in care costs) remains objectively present as a motive, even though its origin is fully documented and explained.
translations.t0082: The boarding passes and photographer's raw files were described by the investigator as 'Verified' but are not contained in the available case file as standalone documents — the verification rests solely on investigator's note NB-L72.
translations.t0083: For the entire offence window, multiple independent, investigator-verified pieces of evidence physically place Ammann in Lisbon: card transactions (Hotel Avenida Lisbon on the day of the offence, Zurich Airport the day before), calendar entries (flight and rehearsal dinner), out-of-office reply, and the investigator's explicit confirmation of flights, hotel and photographer's raw files. The evidence is not entirely independent of each other (calendar and out-of-office could be a prepared cover story), but card transactions and photographer timestamps are external, hard-to-manipulate sources. The slight deduction of 1.0 remains because the photographer's raw files themselves are not present in the case file, and because the physical impossibility of committing the offence (Lisbon vs. St. Gallen) is not conclusively proven by non-stop-flight evidence with gate data — but it is very well supported by converging independent sources.
translations.t0084: While Iris Ammann had the deepest knowledge of the stolen artefacts and signed the audit stop, she has been physically placed in Lisbon throughout the entire offence window (23:10 CEST Friday to 05:58 CEST Saturday) by investigator-verified, converging evidence — card transactions, hotel record, calendar, out-of-office and confirmed photographer timestamps practically exclude her as the perpetrator. The points of suspicion (knowledge, access, motive) are factually explainable and are further undermined by Ammann's proactive cooperation and her documented efforts to close security gaps.

translations.t0086: A physically present third party to whom Ammann could have passed on knowledge in advance is not excluded by the case file — the exculpation relates to direct perpetration, not to aiding and abetting or commissioning.

translations.t0088: Ammann's knowledge of the Real/Decoy mapping and the undocumented staging path remains the most precise within the circle of suspects; whether and to whom she may have passed on this knowledge has not been investigated.
